params.caption: 🎮 Grammys 2027: five game soundtracks nominated, from Bond to Star Wars The nominations for the Grammy for Best Score Soundtrack for Video Games are in, with five games in the running this year. The shortlist includes scores from a James Bond game, a Star Wars game and a Wolverine game, putting some of 2026's biggest licensed releases in contention for music's top award. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 16:40 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC 🎵 Which score deserves the win?
